en: I prayed dawn prayer on time.
I didn't pray the afternoon prayer today.

en: My sister prayed at home with my mother.
She didn't pray with the family.
We prayed Friday prayer with the kids.
We didn't pray afternoon prayer early.
Did you pray dawn prayer in the mosque?

lat: ntuma ma sellitush d-dhur f l-weqt
en: You didn't pray noon prayer on time.
They prayed with their neighbors.

lat: huma ma sellawsh m3ana f d-dar
en: They didn't pray with us at home.
I always pray at the nearby mosque.
I don't pray at work.
You always pray dawn prayer early.
Why don't you pray with the friends?

lat: nti katselli f d-dar kul sba7
en: You (f.) pray at home every morning.
You (f.) don't pray on time.

He doesn't pray with people.
My sister always prays in the room.
She doesn't pray with us now.
We pray every day at home.
We don't pray quickly.
You always pray together.
Why don't you pray here?

lat: huma ma kayselliwsh f had l-bit
en: They don't pray in this room.
Now I am going to pray the afternoon prayer.

lat: ana ma ghadish nselli m3akum l-yum
ar: انا ما غاديش نصلي معاكم اليوم
en: I am not going to pray with you today.
Are you going to pray in the mosque?

lat: nta ma ghadish tselli m3ana l-lila
ar: نتا ما غاديش تصلي معانا الليلة
en: You are not going to pray with us tonight.
Are you going to pray noon prayer now?

lat: nti ma ghadish tselli f had l-makan
ar: نتي ما غاديش تصلي فهاد المكان
en: You are not going to pray in this place.
My brother is going to pray with his friends.

lat: huwa ma ghadish yselli l-fjer ghedda
ar: هو ما غاديش يصلي الفجر غدا
en: He is not going to pray dawn prayer tomorrow.

lat: mmi ghadi tselli d-dhur f d-dar
en: My mother is going to pray noon prayer at home.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tselli m3ana l-3sha
ar: هي ما غاديش تصلي معانا العشا
en: She is not going to pray night prayer with us.
We are going to pray with the neighbors.
We are not going to pray in the alley.

lat: wash ntuma ghadi tselliw l-meghreb daba
ar: واش نتوما غادي تصليو المغرب دابا
en: Are you going to pray sunset prayer now?

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tselliw m3a l-ustad
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تصليو مع الاستاذ
en: You are not going to pray with the teacher.

lat: huma ghadi yselliw f d-dar ghedda
en: They are going to pray at home tomorrow.

lat: huma ma ghadish yselliw l-fjer l-yum
ar: هما ما غاديش يصليو الفجر اليوم
en: They are not going to pray dawn prayer today.
